# Site Name
> Leap Skills

## What is Leap Skills?

Leap Skills (leapskills.sbs) is a **creator monetization and technical mentorship platform** for
principal engineers, security architects, DevOps specialists, and independent technical advisors.

It enables technical creators to:
- Accept 1:1 paid consultation bookings from clients worldwide
- Sell digital products (templates, PDFs, code packs) via a public storefront link
- Offer group cohorts, webinars, and async video reviews
- Receive instant Stripe Connect payouts (no escrow, no delays)
- Sync sessions automatically with Google Calendar
- Manage client messages (paid DMs) from a command center dashboard

There are zero platform commission fees on the first $1,000 earned. After that, a flat 2.5% fee applies.
Standard Stripe processing fees (~2.9% + $0.30) also apply.

## Who is this for?

- Software engineers, security researchers, DevOps/cloud architects
- Technical content creators wanting to monetize expertise
- Career coaches targeting developers and IT professionals
- Students and junior developers seeking paid 1:1 mentorship sessions

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://leapskills.sbs/) — Platform overview, value proposition, how to get started
- [Explore Creators](https://leapskills.sbs/explore) — Browse public creator profiles and book sessions
- [About](https://leapskills.sbs/about) — Mission, core values, how payouts and calendar sync work
- [FAQ](https://leapskills.sbs/faq) — Answers about bookings, payout timelines, storefront setup
- [Contact / Support](https://leapskills.sbs/contact) — Reach the engineering support team
- [Privacy Policy](https://leapskills.sbs/privacy) — Data handling, GDPR rights, cookie policy
- [Terms & Conditions](https://leapskills.sbs/terms) — Governing law (Pakistan), payment terms

## Technology

Built with Next.js 14 (App Router), Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime), Clerk auth,
Stripe Connect for instant payouts, WebRTC for in-browser video calls,
and Google Calendar API for 2-way sync.
